text:
emma_cs: Heads-up intake from Lynx Checkout (acct LX) 1 they want a candidate reranker for POS product suggestions + 1024-dim embeddings for personalization analytics. Pilot: hosted for 3 weeks, SLA ask: p99 <= 65ms for top-10 rerank (avg payload ~70 tokens).

omar_solutions: thanks Emma. Are we getting golden reorder labels? We'll need ~2k labeled requests for a proper offline eval. Also confirm they won't send raw PANs or full order ids.

luke_product: LX can provide 1k seed labels now, partner labeling will deliver remaining 1k in 10 days. They will mask order ids and provide salted hashes for mapping. Pilot goal: show >0.05 NDCG uplift.

kevin_sre: latency note: 65ms p99 is tight for hosted if we make separate calls per candidate. Options: single-pass concat scorer, compact 3B int8 scorer, client prefilter to 10, or Dedicated fallback (2xA10). We'll test concat + q4x quant.

zoe_privacy: privacy checklist: require client-side redaction before upload, DPA signed prior to storing embeddings, and log-redact enabled in staging. No retention of unhashed order ids. I'll own the checklist.

omar_solutions: action items:
1) ingest seed (1k) and labels from customer  LX (ETA 24h)
2) offline eval harness (NDCG@10, RR@1, per-merchant fairness)  omar_solutions (ETA 4d)
3) perf microbenchmarks: concat scorer on 3B q4x + 7B q8 (kevin_sre) (ETA 3d)
4) privacy DPA + redaction signoff (zoe_privacy) (ETA 5d)
5) enablement call + integration doc (emma_cs) propose Fri 10am PT

luke_product: We'll upload seed CSV + hashed mapping tonight via SFTP. Also prefer CDN caching for embeddings export.

kevin_sre: perf command we'll run in staging:
```
./bench_rerank --model ./models/3b-concat-q4x --batch 12 --seq 72 --warmup 300 --measure p50,p95,p99
```

omar_solutions: acceptance criteria: NDCG@10 uplift >= 0.05 and per-merchant delta < 0.025. If latency can't meet SLO on hosted, recommend Dedicated trial.

zoe_privacy: I'll post DPA checklist and required config snippet for redaction. @luke_product please ensure customer-side salt is shared out-of-band.

emma_cs: flagged as high-priority for renewal risk/upsell. Please update account tracker and flag blockers here.

luke_product: seed upload started: lynx_rerank_seed_v1.tar.gz (6.8MB) via sftp. Will send hashed mapping separately.

upload-bot: Upload received: lynx_rerank_seed_v1.tar.gz (6.8MB) sftp@incoming 2246001150

emma_cs: thanks team  we'll reconvene after perf + offline eval.
